<b>API Key</b> —— 仅用于在请求头中向你选择的平台鉴权: API key — used only to authenticate your requests to the provider you chose
<b>不会发送</b>：你没有主动翻译的页面内容、浏览历史、Cookie、表单数: Never sent: page content you did not ask to translate, browsing history, cookies, or form data. The extension does not scan or upload anything in the background.
<b>元素翻译</b>：右键页面上的某个区域给它挂一个翻译按钮，点击后就地替换区: Element translation: right-click a region of the page to attach a translate button to it; clicking it replaces the text in place. Rules are remembered per domain and can be managed on the rules page.
<b>元素翻译规则</b> —— 你手动添加的「域名 + CSS 选择器」: Element translation rules — the "domain + CSS selector" entries you added yourself
<b>划词翻译</b>：选中非中文文字后右键翻译，译文在屏幕中央的弹窗里流式显示: Selection translation: select non-Chinese text and right-click to translate; the translation streams into a popup in the middle of the screen. If the selection is already Chinese, the menu item does not appear.
<b>加载扩展</b> <span>——点「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选中刚才那个: Load the extension — click "Load unpacked" and pick the folder you just extracted.
<b>图片翻译</b>：右键图片识别其中的文字，译文按位置盖回原图。长图会先按内: Image translation: right-click an image to read the text inside it; the translation is placed back over the original at the detected positions. Long images are split into content-aware tiles, with the seams kept between lines of text.
<b>填入 API Key</b> <span>——首次安装会自动打开设置页。选: Add your API key — the settings page opens on first install. Pick a provider, paste the key, and hit "Test connection".
<b>开源</b> GPL-3.0 · 自备 API Key: Open source GPL-3.0 · Bring your own API key
<b>打开扩展页</b> <span>——地址栏输入 <span class=\: Open the extensions page — type chrome://extensions/ in the address bar and turn on "Developer mode" in the top right.
<b>拿到源码</b> <span>——在 GitHub 上 Download: Get the source — download the ZIP from GitHub and unzip it, or git clone the repository.
<b>翻译面板</b>：独立页面，左原文右译文，目标语言可任选。: Translation panel: a standalone page with the source on the left and the translation on the right; pick any target language.

API Key 存在 <span class=\"mono\">chrome.s: The API key is stored in chrome.storage.local, is not synced through your Chrome account, and is used only to authenticate your requests to the provider you chose. Uninstalling the extension removes it.
Key 留在本机: Your key stays on your machine
一个 Chrome 扩展。网页里的外文、整块区域、甚至图片里的文字，都能就地译成: A Chrome extension. Foreign text on a page, whole regions, even text inside images — translated in place. The translation streams in word by word, using your own API key, with no server in between.
一个独立页面，左边贴原文右边出译文，适合处理成段的、不在网页上的文字。: A standalone page with the source on the left and the translation on the right, for passages that are not on a web page.
不使用统计、埋点、广告或任何第三方 SDK: No analytics, telemetry, advertising, or third-party SDKs of any kind
不出售、不出租、不分享任何数据给第三方: No selling, renting, or sharing of any data with third parties
不用于信用评估或与扩展功能无关的用途: No use for creditworthiness or anything unrelated to the extension's function
不用切换标签页，不用复制粘贴。看不懂的那一段在哪，翻译就发生在哪。: No tab switching, no copy-paste. Wherever the part you cannot read is, that is where the translation happens.
也有快捷键：<span class=\"mono\">Alt+Shift+T</: There is a keyboard shortcut too: Alt+Shift+T (Command+Shift+Y on macOS)
仅作用于你当前操作的那个标签页: Act only on the tab you are working in
仅当你填写了自定义接口地址（代理或中转）时申请，且只申请那一个域名；在点击「测试: Requested only if you enter a custom API base URL (a proxy or relay), and only for that single origin. The prompt appears when you click "Test connection"; it never asks for all sites
以下数据通过 <code>chrome.storage.local</code>: The following is stored on your device via chrome.storage.local. It is not synced through your Chrome account and never leaves your browser:
作者不运营任何服务器，也没有统计、埋点、广告或第三方 SDK。你翻译过什么，这边: The author runs no servers and uses no analytics, tracking, advertising or third-party SDKs. What you translated is something we have no way of knowing.
你可以随时在设置页清空这些数据，或直接卸载扩展（卸载会一并删除）。: You can clear all of it from the options page at any time, or simply uninstall the extension (uninstalling removes it all).
你可能在任何网页上划词翻译；且需在右键之前判断选中的文字是否为中文，以决定菜单是: You may select text on any page; and the extension must know whether the selected text is already Chinese before the right-click, to decide whether the menu item appears
你在翻译面板输入的文字: Text you type into the translation panel
你指定区域内的文字: The text inside a region you marked
内容，并且只发往你自己选定的那: text you ask it to translate, and
十余种目标语言可选，不限于中文: A dozen or so target languages, not just Chinese
只有你主动触发翻译时，内容才会发出去，并且只发往你自己选定的那家平台。这不是一句: Content leaves your browser only when you trigger a translation, and only to the provider you chose. That is not a promise — it is a fact you can check line by line in the source.
只有在你<b>主动触发翻译</b>时（右键菜单、快捷键、点击翻译按钮）， 以下内: Only when you actively trigger a translation (context menu, keyboard shortcut, or clicking a translate button) is the following sent over HTTPS to the provider you selected in Settings:
可折叠的原文面板，对照着读: A collapsible source panel to read alongside the translation
可能是链接写错了，也可能是原来的地址已经改掉。下面两个入口是好的。: The link may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. These two entries work.
可选的平台为 <b>OpenAI（ChatGPT）</b>、<b>DeepSee: The available providers are OpenAI (ChatGPT), DeepSeek and DeepL; requests go to https://api.openai.com, https://api.deepseek.com, and to https://api-free.deepl.com for DeepL (or https://api.deepl.com with a paid key). How they handle that content is governed by their own privacy policies:
可选：访问你自己的接口域名: Optional access to your own API origin
右键一张图片，识别图里的文字，再把译文按识别到的位置盖回原图上。: Right-click an image, read the text inside it, and place the translation back over the original at the detected positions.
右键页面上的某个区域，给它挂一个翻译按钮。点一下，区域里的文字就地换成中文。: Right-click a region of a page to attach a translate button to it. One click and the text inside that region is replaced in place.
向你选定的平台发送翻译请求: Send translation requests to the provider you selected
四个入口，都在右键菜单里: Four entry points, all in the right-click menu
在你触发翻译时向当前页面注入所需脚本: Inject the needed script into the current page when you trigger a translation
在右键菜单提供翻译入口: Provide the translate entries in the right-click menu
在本机保存上述设置: Save the settings above on your machine
完整说明见<a class=\"link\" href=\"privacy.ht: Full details in the privacy policy, and the complete source, public under GPL-3.0.
家平台: only to the platform you choose.
平台和目标语言就在工具栏上，随时切换重译: Provider and target language sit in the toolbar; switch and re-translate at any time
弹窗居中且可拖动，<span class=\"mono\">Esc</span>: The popup is centered and draggable, closes with Esc or a click on the backdrop — not a little bubble chasing your cursor
所有发往翻译平台的请求都写在 <span class=\"mono\">src/: Every request to a translation provider lives in a single file, src/lib/providers.js, and goes only to the provider selected in your settings. No other code sends your content anywhere.
扩展的全部源代码以 GPL-3.0 公开，可自行核实： <a class=\"l: The complete source code is public under GPL-3.0, so you can verify all of the above: github.com/csswork/AiTranslation.
攒下的规则可以在管理页逐条查看和删除: Saved rules can be reviewed and deleted one by one on the rules page
支持接入 ChatGPT（OpenAI）、DeepSeek 与 DeepL 的: Works with the ChatGPT (OpenAI), DeepSeek and DeepL APIs; switch providers from the popup or the settings page at any time.
支持接入 ChatGPT（OpenAI）与 DeepSeek 的 API，随时可: Works with the ChatGPT (OpenAI) and DeepSeek APIs, and you can switch at any time. Both default to their cheapest tier — translation is high-frequency, short-input work, so there is no need to pay for the expensive models.

本扩展不收集、不存储、不上传任何用户数据到我们的服务器——<b>我们没有服务器<: This extension collects nothing, stores nothing on our servers, and uploads nothing to us — we do not operate any server. What you ask it to translate is sent only to the AI provider you configured.

This project is an independent open-source work, not affiliated with, authorised by, or partnered with OpenAI, DeepSeek, DeepL or their affiliates. ChatGPT, DeepSeek, DeepL and other names are trademarks of their respective owners, named here only to describe the APIs this extension can talk to.
没有服务器，就没有可以泄露的地方: No servers means nothing to leak
版本号取自 <span class=\"mono\">manifest.json: Version numbers come from manifest.json. For finer-grained changes, see the repository's commit log.
目前以开发者模式加载。需要 Chrome 116 或更高版本，以及一个你自己的: Currently loaded in developer mode. Requires Chrome 116 or later, and an API key of your own.
直到下一次，你又选中了一段看不懂的文字。: Until the next time you select a passage you cannot read.
结果在独立窗口打开，可以和原图对照着看: Results open in a separate window so you can compare them with the original
自动判断输入语言：中文默认译成英文，其他语言默认译成中文: Detects the input language: Chinese is translated into English by default, everything else into Chinese
装上它，然后忘了它: Install it, then forget about it
规则按域名记住，下次再来同一个网站，按钮自动挂上: Rules are remembered per domain, so the button is attached automatically the next time you visit that site
送检前按总像素缩放而不是按最长边，长图的宽度不会被压没: Images are scaled by total pixel count rather than by the longest edge, so the width of a long image is not squeezed away
选中一段非中文文字，右键点「翻译成中文」，译文在屏幕中央的弹窗里逐字出现。: Select a passage of non-Chinese text, right-click and choose "Translate into Chinese"; the translation appears word by word in a popup in the middle of the screen.
选中的本来就是中文时菜单不出现，纯数字、标点、表情同理: If the selection is already Chinese the menu item does not appear; the same goes for plain numbers, punctuation and emoji
长内容分批送出，边译边替换，不用等整块跑完: Long content is sent in batches and replaced as it is translated, so you do not wait for the whole region
长图会先切块再识别，切缝自动挪到文字之间的空白行，不会把一句话劈成两半: Long images are split into tiles before recognition, with the seams moved to the blank lines between text so a sentence is never cut in half
